results.title: Lechindi Mahila Lokam
results.overview: Centers women's voices in a narrative of empowerment and resistance. The Telugu film weaves together diverse female experiences, examining how women balance societal expectations, personal goals, and systemic obstacles.

results.title: Unraveling the Dream
results.overview: In The Doors of Perception (1954), Aldous Huxley wrote that the urge to transcend self-consciousness was "a principle appetite of the soul." He hoped that psychedelics would make the experience of self-transcendence more widely available, and thereby catalyze a transformation in the culture.  But experiencing ego dissolution is one thing; integrating it into ordinary life is another. And, as the misadventures of the 1960s attest, building a culture around self-transcendence is a perilous (if inspiring) endeavor.  “Unraveling the Dream,” a new film presented by the Waking Up meditation app, explores whether the new science of psychedelics might shed fresh light on Huxley’s vision. Featuring original interviews with Anil Seth, Robin Carhart-Harris, and Shamil Chandaria, the film takes viewers on a sweeping journey to the frontiers of neuroscience and through the rich, turbulent history of psychedelics.

results.title: Memory of Princess Mumbi
results.overview: In 2093, filmmaker Kuve travels to Umata to document the aftermath of a war that revived ancient kingdoms. There, he meets Mumbi, who challenges him to make his film without the use of AI. As Kuve searches for his own voice, he begins to realize that even in a broken world, beauty can be found in the small human moments we often overlook.

results.title: Before We Fall Asleep
results.overview: Follows a couple whose relationship begins to fracture as shifting dynamics expose unspoken fears and quiet resentments.

results.title: Love & New Notes
results.overview: A couple expecting a child makes the drastic decision to attempt a robbery, finding themselves out of their depth with the homeowners they try to steal from.

results.title: Out of Date Defences
results.overview: Behind so many of the troubles of love lies a frustrating mystery: why do they behave the way they do? Late at night, we might write them off as mean, lazy, or actively trying to ruin our lives.

results.title: SKIN
results.overview: A simple tattoo session becomes a quiet reckoning as a man learns to stop running, embrace his history, and love the person he’s becoming.

results.title: The Peril at Pincer Point
results.overview: On a quest to prove his competency, an inept sound recordist finds himself entangled in a nautical prophecy on the spectral island of Pincer Point.

results.title: Another
results.overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

results.title: The Trade
results.overview: Sunny is a resilient young Latina forced to shoulder adult responsibilities due to her father Nada's severe drug addiction. Tasked with managing the cooking, cleaning, and keeping up appearances for her family and neighbors, Sunny must also constantly stand guard at home to stop local dealers from supplying her father.

results.title: Always On
results.overview: After moving into his parents’ basement, Bronson Somatz deals with his breakup the only way he knows how: impromptu therapy sessions in the back of an ice cream truck, escapes to his ever-devolving daydreams, and a whole lotta Tennessee whiskey.

results.title: 13 Souls
results.overview: Following her mother’s death, fifteen-year-old Agne moves in with her estranged father and older sister near a cemetery where he works. There, she uncovers a mysterious and deadly connection between her family and the “13 Souls” — victims of a tragic, unsolved fire decades earlier. As the past resurfaces and strange phenomena escalate, Agne finds herself entangled in a supernatural mystery tied to possession, reincarnation, and long-buried guilt.

results.title: Offshore
results.overview: Elias, along with the dwindling marine life surrounding the oil rig he starts working on gets affected more and more by the noise and harshness of the platform, until everything comes to an abrupt halt.

results.title: Arachnobody
results.overview: Arachnobody is a symbolically colored short film about a character who suddenly falls ill and isolates himself. Seeking to return to normal life, he turns to a doctor whose help comes at a cost, reflecting a society where kindness is often given only when there's something to gain.

results.title: Heartworm
results.overview: In a near future where virtual reality has become a refuge for the grieving, Heartworm follows Avena, a bereaved mother struggling to pull her family back from the edge of disappearance. Her husband Mark has retreated into NeuraLife, a fully immersive AI world that promises comfort, continuity, and escape from unbearable loss. As Avena searches for a way to reconnect with him, she’s drawn into a disorienting journey through memory, technology, and longing. Featuring a striking breakout performance by Broadway star Amber Gray, Heartworm asks a haunting question for our time: when comfort is infinite, what becomes of being human?

results.title: Each Other
results.overview: Enemies at school. friends at home. Two brothers navigate childhood with and without each other.
